vb_textbox.text: Stay alert, get your hands comfortable and concentrate. It is easy to miss a turn if you take  too long to decide, so go with your gut feeling.Look for a pattern if the brighter gnome gives you more mushrooms then go with that, if it starts to give a lower amount then switch to the darker gnome.If you think gnomes with a certain colour of hat at lucky then pick them.don't forget, the more mushrooms means more bonus.
